verdict.rationale: Stripe's own webhook docs list events sent after a balance, ownership, or transaction refresh completes. That shows refreshes exist and finish asynchronously with a completion signal. The pack never shows the API call that triggers an on-demand refresh, and one community report describes a limit to only daily pulls, which leaves on-demand refresh frequency uncertain. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented API endpoint or parameter to trigger an on-demand refresh, documented refresh semantics (rate limits, statuses, latency), and hands-on corroboration that on-demand refresh works.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trigger an on-demand refresh of a connected account's data through the API when my use case needs now-fresh data, with the refresh semantics documented
